input.rationale: Section 8.2 binds Ono and its Affiliates not to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory. The product scope is acceptable at fallback because Competing Product is confined to two specified compound classes (excluding Binimetinib and Encorafenib), but the covenant fails fallback on duration and carve-outs: it extends past termination to an unspecified anniversary of the termination date, the in-term period is likewise open-ended, and there is no carve-out for Ono's internal development or for products or programs acquired by Ono. An open-ended post-term non-compete is walk-away territory. We therefore narrowed Ono's covenant to the term, capped it at twelve months, and added internal-development and acquisition carve-outs; Array's reciprocal restriction (which benefits us) and Array's termination right under Section 8.2, cross-referenced in Article XIV, are left intact.

proposal.summary: Limit Ono's exclusivity covenant in Section 8.2 to the term of the Agreement, cap it at 12 months, and carve out internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a post-termination non-compete of undefined length binding Ono and its Affiliates, so we have deleted the post-termination extension and confined Ono's Section 8.2 covenant to the term of the Agreement, capped at twelve (12) months, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquired products or programs. Array's side of the exclusivity is untouched; this reflects our fallback position on non-compete restrictions.

ops.oldText: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement "at will" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: Ono's and its Affiliates' obligations under this Section 8.2 shall apply only during the term of this Agreement and shall in no event extend beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date, and shall not restrict (i) Ono's or its Affiliates' internal research or Development activities or (ii) any product or program acquired by Ono or its Affiliates through any acquisition of or merger with a Third Party.
